_doc: `renamed_on_github`: declared name -> current GitHub repo name (the SoT registry renamed it, the hub pin and folder follow later); generators use the GitHub name for API reads and URLs. SoT of the html site repos this hub mounts as submodules (owner-declared). .gitmodules and the gitlinks are derived from it: node scripts/gen-gitmodules.mjs [--check]. Each repo is mounted at a root folder of the same name; the two base entries keep their historical folders. All Projects-* html repos are listed (Projects-___ is the Projects hub, mounted per repo under 0_hub, so it is not repeated here).

no_deploy.project-pvt-all: PRIVATE: aggregated as a submodule only, never in any public deploy/Pages list
